primary-1.$description: Surface in primary color 1 (Red), one of Arizona's two primary brand colors. Used by the original red Arizona Header, which Arizona Bootstrap plans to deprecate (az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299) — aliases the brand palette.

primary-2.$description: Surface in primary color 2 (Blue), one of Arizona's two primary brand colors. Used by the Arizona Header, the default since Arizona Bootstrap 5.2 (az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299) — aliases the brand palette.

default.$description: Text and icons on surface.primary-1 — aliases the brand palette.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.primary-1 — aliases the brand palette.

default.$description: Text and icons on surface.primary-2 — aliases the brand palette.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring on surface.primary-2 — aliases the brand palette.

height.$description: Header height: its minimum height at every screen size, and its fixed height below 992px. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

color.$description: Header fill: primary color 2 (Blue), the default since Arizona Bootstrap 5.2. Per az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299.

The original red header's fill: primary color 1 (Red). Replaces container.color. Arizona Bootstrap plans to deprecate the red header; don't use it for new sites. Per az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2299.
Keyboard focus ring on the original red header's logo and buttons; replaces focus-visible.ring.color. Per Arizona Bootstrap.
Header button text and icon color on the original red header; replaces button.label.color. Per Arizona Bootstrap.
Keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons, drawn inside the element's edge. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

width.$description: Width of the inset keyboard focus ring on the logo and header buttons. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the logo and header buttons while they have keyboard focus, so the ring has rounded corners. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

color.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) text and icon color. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

min-width.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) minimum width. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

min-height.$description: Header button (.btn-arizona-header) minimum height: the header's own height. Per Arizona Bootstrap.

scroll-offset.$description: When the header is fixed on mobile (below 992px): how far below the top of the screen linked sections stop when scrolled to, so the header doesn't cover them. Per Arizona Bootstrap.
